scope: Microeconomic theory: game theory and networks; mechanism and market design; information and contracts; decision and social choice; general equilibrium foundations; theoretical industrial organization.
policy: Daily discovery produces candidates, not automatic public recommendations. Publication requires a content-specific approval matching the current title, authors and abstract fingerprint. There is no daily publication quota.
limits: Codex-assisted scope and contribution screening, not peer review, proof verification, a ranking, or a guarantee of novelty or quality. Author reputation and institutional affiliation are not admission rules. Papers not selected are not judged to be poor research.
outside_scope: Empirical or calibrated macroeconomics, growth and asset-pricing exercises without a primary microeconomic-theory contribution
Engineering, transport and operational optimization whose principal contribution is an application or numerical procedure
Management frameworks, policy commentary and conceptual essays without a substantive microeconomic-theory contribution
boundary_note: Applications to macroeconomics, finance, public policy or technology do not disqualify a paper whose main contribution is to microeconomic-theory foundations.
